purpose: Frozen held-out Weather confirmation for the selected MambaTS v3 AutoCon candidate and fixed strong baselines.
research_question: On fresh seeds and a held-out Weather test split, is the preselected MambaTS v3 AutoCon forecaster non-inferior to registered nonlinear baselines?
evidence_boundary: This is a single-dataset held-out confirmation. It may support Weather-specific claims under this frozen budget, but cannot establish cross-dataset generalization, universal Mamba superiority, or a standalone AutoCon gain.
claim_boundary: Validation loss restores the best epoch only. Test metrics are read once after all registered jobs finish and cannot select a model, lambda, horizon, or subsequent architecture.

required_before_launch: verify the immutable Weather data fingerprint and exact 75-job expansion
freeze active AutoCon lambda=0.001 without test-based tuning
record that held-out test metrics are read once and never used for architecture selection
reserve a matched post-training resource protocol for all claimed nonlinear comparators

confirmation_contract.selection_metric: best validation scaled MSE for checkpoint restoration only
confirmation_contract.test_read_gate: Aggregate results only after every phase validator succeeds and no test metric may change the registered matrix.
confirmation_contract.independence_note: Forecast windows are not inferential replicates; paired seed-level contrasts are the unit of uncertainty reporting.

phases.name: weather_selection_confirmatory_active_test
phases.purpose: Preselected MambaTS v3 AutoCon candidate with fixed lambda=0.001.

phases.name: weather_confirmatory_strong_baselines_test
phases.purpose: Fixed strong nonlinear baseline reference under the identical Weather contract.

comparison_contract.primary_contrast: MambaTSv3AutoCon lambda=0.001 versus each registered external baseline
comparison_contract.mechanism_evidence_boundary: The exact lambda-zero null is validation-only mechanism evidence and is excluded from this strict test confirmation because it was not promoted as a stable long-horizon treatment.

statistical_gate.paired_effect: seed-level log(MSE_candidate / MSE_reference) and raw scaled-MSE delta
statistical_gate.interpretation: For a claimed Weather cell, the one-sided 95 percent paired-t upper confidence bound for candidate/reference MSE must be at most 1.02. Failure is inconclusive or unfavorable, not evidence of equivalence.
statistical_gate.small_n_warning: Five seeds support uncertainty reporting but do not justify a universal or cross-dataset conclusion.

required_after_training: matched end-to-end training wall-time from manifests
resource_contract.efficiency_boundary: Do not claim a universal speed advantage. Report each comparator separately; a speed statement requires no worse confirmed Weather accuracy in that cell and matched settings.
